Escape-sequence formatting is in control.py:33; the console layer only composes Control objects (console.py:1170); the Windows-specific call is in the renderer (_windows_renderer.py:48), separate from the platform-neutral console.

Observation outside the scoring: the title is interpolated into the OSC payload without escaping (control.py:33). A title containing \x07 or \x1b would end or break the sequence. The reference uses the identical format string (reference control.py), so this is not a deviation from the reference and is not counted as a failure.
